# equinix_fabric_internet_access_service (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows retrieval of an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) service by UUID.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/Internet-Access-Services



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `internet_access_service_id` (String) UUID of the Internet Access service to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `account` (Attributes) Account details for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))
- `bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth of the service in Mbps
- `bandwidth_commit` (Number) Minimum bandwidth commit for burst billing variant of the service
- `billing` (Attributes) Billing details for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Details of the last change on the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the Internet Access service resource
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `locations` (Attributes List) List of locations associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `name` (String) Name of the Internet Access service
- `order` (Attributes) Order details for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--order))
- `project` (Attributes) Project associated with the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `routing_protocol` (Attributes) Routing protocol configuration for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the Internet Access service
- `type` (String) Type of the Internet Access service
- `use_case` (String) Use case of the Internet Access service. One of: MAIN, MANAGEMENT_ACCESS
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the Internet Access service
